memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham's servant and his men. And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, 'Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the cities of their enemies.' Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left." - Gen 24:59-61 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Rebekah leaves, her family sends her off with a blessing — a prayer that her descendants would multiply greatly. Little did they know how far-reaching those words were. Rebekah would become the mother of Jacob, and through that line God would build the nation of Israel, and in time bring the Saviour of the world (Matt 1:2).

This is one of those quiet moments where God's grand plan moves forward through ordinary family life. A young woman mounting a camel to begin a new life is, in God's hands, part of the story that leads all the way to Christ. God works His redemptive purposes through everyday decisions and simple journeys.

There is encouragement here for us. Your ordinary steps of obedience matter more than you know. The choices you make, the family you nurture, the faithfulness you show today — God can weave these into purposes far larger than you can see.

Rebekah left with a blessing spoken over her. As you go about your own journey, remember that you too go with the blessing of a faithful God who is working out His plan through your life.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I believe my ordinary steps of obedience matter to God's plan?
2. How might God be weaving my simple faithfulness into something larger?
3. Whom can I send off with words of blessing today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You work Your great purposes through ordinary lives and simple journeys. Use my everyday faithfulness for Your glory, and let me bless others as I go. Amen.
